intro: Decisions that need answers before a hotel or restaurant choice is reasonable. 'Known' lists what official sources support. 'Missing' lists what cannot be answered from verified data.

questions.question: How many nights, and which dates?
questions.known: Preferred Feb 15-18, 2027 (3 nights). Trip window Feb 15-Mar 23, 2027. Trip length 1-2 weeks. Pricing requested for 7 nights.
questions.missing: The user has not chosen between 3 nights and 7 nights. These totals are not interchangeable.
questions.how_to_resolve: Ask the user to choose: (A) 3 nights Feb 15-18; (B) 7 nights Feb 15-22; (C) another 7-night window in the Feb 15-Mar 23 range.

questions.question: What is the 7-night total for each hotel for two adults, with taxes and resort fees?
questions.known: Official sites show booking engines and promo banners only. No dated Feb 2027 total was retrieved.
questions.missing: Live rates for Feb 15-22, 2027, refundable and non-refundable, with taxes and resort fees.
questions.how_to_resolve: Run each official booking engine for the exact dates and 2 adults. Save each screen as a dated snapshot with its URL and time.
questions.status: OPEN (cannot be verified from this environment)

questions.question: When is the cheapest time to book?
questions.known: Official offers show advance-purchase discounts (for example Caesars: up to 30% off for stays 30+ days ahead). Terms vary.
questions.missing: No rate history for these dates, so no verified cheapest booking date.
questions.how_to_resolve: Record dated rate snapshots weekly from now until the chosen dates. Then compare them.

questions.question: Does each room have a private bathroom?
questions.known: The Venetian's official listing shows an 'Oversized Bathroom'. Wynn's official room page mentions a 'spacious bathroom'. Other listings do not state it.
questions.missing: Explicit private-bathroom confirmation for most hotels.
questions.how_to_resolve: Open each official room detail page and record the bathroom wording.

questions.question: Does each room meet 'queen or bigger'?
questions.known: Official listings show 2 Queen Beds for Bellagio, MGM Grand, Cosmopolitan, Venetian, ARIA, Wynn and Caesars. King rooms are also listed. Resorts World was not verified.
questions.how_to_resolve: Check the Resorts World official room page.

questions.question: Which hotel has the most Michelin restaurants within one hour by bus or subway?
questions.known: On-property counts (verified): The Venetian 4 (Recommended); MGM Grand 2 (both starred); The Cosmopolitan 2 (1 starred + Bib); Bellagio, Caesars, ARIA, Wynn, Resorts World 1 each. Las Vegas has no subway.
questions.missing: Travel times for each hotel to each restaurant (RTC bus or monorail). Not verified.
questions.how_to_resolve: Use the official RTC Trip Planner for each hotel-restaurant pair on the planned day and time. Record the results with a date.

questions.question: Which restaurants are currently starred?
questions.known: 2026 Michelin Guide Southwest: Joël Robuchon (2 stars), L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon (1), é by José Andrés (1), Restaurant Guy Savoy (1). Official MGM pages confirm the first three.
questions.missing: Michelin's own guide.michelin.com pages could not be fetched here. Guy Savoy's official weekly hours are not visible.
questions.how_to_resolve: Check guide.michelin.com manually for each restaurant. Confirm Guy Savoy's full hours on its official page.

questions.question: Which restaurants are open on the chosen nights?
questions.known: Joël Robuchon and é by José Andrés are both closed Mondays and Sundays. L'Atelier is closed Tuesday and Wednesday. China Poblano has daily hours.
questions.missing: Hours for most Recommended and Bib venues.
questions.how_to_resolve: Read hours on each official page and check for holiday changes around Presidents' Day (Feb 15, 2027).

questions.question: Does the stay fall on Presidents' Day?
questions.known: Yes. Monday Feb 15, 2027 is Washington's Birthday (OPM). If the stay is Feb 15-18 or Feb 15-22, check-in falls on the holiday.
questions.missing: Effect on prices and crowds. Not verified.
questions.how_to_resolve: Compare rates for Feb 14-15 with Feb 16-22 at the same hotels.

questions.question: How do we get around, and what are the travel-time limits?
questions.known: RTC runs a bus network (39 routes). The Las Vegas Monorail has 7 Strip stations. Red Rock has no public transit and needs timed entry Oct 1 to May 31. Valley of Fire can strand rideshare users.
questions.missing: Whether the group will rent a car. Actual travel times.
questions.how_to_resolve: Ask the user about a rental car. Then run the RTC Trip Planner for the chosen pairs.

questions.question: Which activities does the group want?
questions.known: Candidate activities (official sites): Hoover Dam, Red Rock Canyon, Valley of Fire, Fremont Street, Sphere, Las Vegas Monorail.
questions.missing: The user's priority list. Hours and fees for several activities.
questions.how_to_resolve: Ask the user to rank activities. Then verify each chosen activity's hours and fees on its official page.

questions.question: Do the restaurants and activities have TikTok, Instagram or YouTube accounts?
questions.known: Official pages confirm only agency-level accounts (Bureau of Reclamation, BLM) and the Monorail's @lvmonorail Instagram.
questions.missing: Venue-level social accounts for most restaurants and attractions.
questions.how_to_resolve: Read each official site's footer for social links. Record a link only when it appears on that site.

questions.question: Are there resort fees and extra charges to include in the total?
questions.known: Not verified from an official source in this session.
questions.how_to_resolve: Read each hotel's official fee disclosure during the booking flow.

questions.question: What budget applies to restaurants for two adults?
questions.known: Official pages give price levels only ($ to $$$$). Dollar totals were not on official pages.
questions.missing: Exact menu prices for two adults.
questions.how_to_resolve: Read the official menus. Estimate only when the menu gives prices, and show the source.
